title: Husked rice import tariffs
summary: EU raises husked rice import tariff to €42.50 per tonne
update: From 7 September 2026, the European Union (EU) import tariff for husked (brown) rice, excluding basmati rice, is €42.50 per tonne.
what_changing: The European Union (EU) has raised the import tariff for husked rice (CN code 1006 20) from €30.00 to €42.50 per tonne. This does not apply to husked basmati rice – for specific eligible varieties of basmati – for which the import tariff is always zero.
why: The import tariff for husked rice (excluding basmati rice) is set in September based on imports in the previous marketing year (September–August).
timeline: The revised import tariff applies from 7 September 2026 .
background: The procedure for establishing import tariffs for husked rice other than basmati rice – the result of negotiations with the USA – is set out in Council Decision 2005/476/EC . Zero duty applies to certain varieties of basmati rice that are listed in Regulation 2023/2835 .
resources: 2005/476/EC : Council Decision on the conclusion of an Agreement in the form of an Exchange of Letters between the European Community and the United States of America relating to the method of calculation of applied duties for husked rice Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/2835 as regards rules on import in the sectors of rice, cereals, sugar and hops
summary_fr: L'UE augmente les droits d'importation du riz décortiqué à 42,50 € la tonne
